description: This file defines a generic class ComparableRange that models a range of comparable values with methods for range comparison, inclusion, and overlap checks.

classes.name: ComparableRange
classes.description: A generic class representing a range of comparable values with methods to compare, check inclusion, and determine overlaps.

methods.name: getStart
methods.description: Returns the start value of the range.

methods.name: getEnd
methods.description: Returns the end value of the range.

methods.name: ComparableRange (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a range object with specified start and end, swapping if necessary.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Checks if this range is after another range or a value.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Checks if this range is before another range or a value.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns the end value of the range.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this range is equal to another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of this range.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this range to another ComparableRange.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Checks if this range includes another range or a specific value.

methods.name: isPoint
methods.description: Determines if this range is a single point.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if this range overlaps with another range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the start value of the range.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the range.
